msg: First, aim for either the green/blue/yellow or orange gnomes. These gnomes will lead you to a yellow basket. Keep aiming for the yellow basket until it yields you to 2 or less mushrooms. Once it does, then aim instead for the purple/red/brown or pink gnomes which will lead you to a red basket. Continue to do so until once again it leads to 2 or less mushrooms discovered, where you will then switch to locate the yellow basket again. Continue this process to yield the most mushrooms. Always start by locating the yellow basket though as this tends to yield higher mushrooms.
